create_stanford_dataset: create a StanfordArea5Dataset instance with config, transforms, and augmentation for 3D semantic segmentation
load_ply_pointcloud: load a PLY point cloud file and return coordinates, features, and semantic labels
test_pointcloud_evaluation: test full point cloud evaluation by joining room predictions and computing per class IoU
augment_coords_to_feats: augment point cloud coordinates by centering and concatenating normalized coords to features
create_stanford_variant_dataset: create a Stanford variant dataset like Area53cm or Area510cm with custom voxel size and clip bound
